messages:
arthur.k: FYI found a vendor commission/implementation fee that was invoiced and recognized in full this period but the services run across Q2-Q3. We need to move to deferral to avoid overstating revenue this month.

melissa.j: Which vendor and amounts?

arthur.k: Vendor = IntegrateNow, INV-IN-2026-078, amount $165,000. Contract shows implementation + 18-month support; billing system recognized whole amt when invoice posted.

gao.w: Oof. That should be split between implementation (one-time recognized) and support (deferral). Looks like billing mapped entire invoice to product code "platform_services" which maps to revenue GL 4100. Need reclass.

melissa.j: Proposed split per contract: $45,000 implementation (recognize immediate), $120,000 support amortized over 18 months -> $6,666.67/mo. Accounting JE to reclassify the $120k from recognized revenue to deferred revenue: 
```
Dr Service Revenue (4100)         $120,000
  Cr Deferred Revenue (2105)       $120,000
```
Then monthly recognition: Dr Deferred Revenue 6,666.67 / Cr Service Revenue 6,666.67.

arthur.k: Need approval for JE. Since amount > $150k total, CFO sign-off required. I've attached contract excerpt to the billing ticket.

billing-bot: Ticket BILL-9519 created by gao.w referencing INV-IN-2026-078. Attachments: invoice_export.csv, contract_excerpt.pdf.

accounts-payable-bot: Note: payment already processed on 2026-05-02. FX impact none (USD).

cfo: Reviewing. Can you confirm the revenue classification rationale and provide mapping of invoice lines?

melissa.j: Mapping: invoice line 1 (implementation) code IMP-001 = $45,000; invoice line 2 (support) code SUP-018 = $120,000. Billing will split rules going forward so the lines map correctly. I'll include a screenshot of the invoice line export.

cfo: OK. Approve the reclass and JE. Please include BILL-9519 and invoice_export in the JE support and tag me on the posting.

arthur.k: Will prepare JE and post in NetSuite as "Reclassify support portion of INV-IN-2026-078 to deferred revenue". JE reference: JE-2026-0897. Will attach BILL-9519 and approval.

gao.w: Billing will change the mapping rule to prevent this going forward. Patch ETA: next release (tomorrow). Will also scan last 6 months for similar invoices and list them in the ticket.

melissa.j: Close pack note draft: "Adjusted revenue recognition for IntegrateNow INV-IN-2026-078. Reclassed $120,000 to deferred revenue (GL2105) to be amortized over 18 months ($6,666.67/mo). Immediate implementation revenue retained $45,000. CFO approval obtained. Supporting docs: BILL-9519, invoice_export.csv, contract_excerpt.pdf, JE-2026-0897."

accounts-payable-bot: Vendor payment reversal not required; this is revenue timing only.

arthur.k: I'll post JE now and ping once uploaded. Thanks.
